verdict.rationale: Cekura's observability pipeline explicitly captures audio (call recording URL) and text (transcript) plus metadata as part of a CallLog, and PII redaction applies to both transcripts and audio recordings, showing multimodal-ish handling for voice data. However there is no evidence of support for arbitrary image or file payloads within traces — the product is voice-agent focused. Missing for 10: image payload capture, generic file attachment support, explicit multimodal trace schema beyond audio+text+metadata.
